definitions.explanation: Refers to a portion of a larger whole.

definitions.gloss: one copy (of a book, document, etc.)
definitions.explanation: Used as a counter for copies of publications or documents.

examples.japanese: ⟦{参加者|さんかしゃ}→参加者：03059_sankasha⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{一部|いちぶ}⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{反対|はんたい}した→反対：01497_hantai⟧。
⟦{計画|けいかく}→計画：01172_keikaku⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{一部|いちぶ}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{変更|へんこう}する→変更：03616_henkou⟧。
examples.english: We'll change part of the plan.

examples.english: Please submit one copy of the application form.

notes:
{一部|いちぶ} has two distinct meanings depending on context.

SENSE 1 — PART/PORTION:
Refers to a portion of a larger whole. Often translates as "some" or "part of."
- {一部|いちぶ}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{人|ひと}→人：00476_hito⟧: some people
- {一部|いちぶ}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{除|のぞ}いて→除く：02391_nozoku⟧: except for a part
- 〜⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{一部|いちぶ}⟦として→として：noentry⟧: as part of 〜
- {一部|いちぶ}⟦{始終|しじゅう}→始終：04192_shijuu⟧: the whole story, full details

SENSE 2 — ONE COPY:
A counter for copies of documents, books, or publications.
- {一部|いちぶ}: one copy
- {二部|にぶ}: two copies
- {三部|さんぶ}: three copies

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{全部|ぜんぶ}→全部：02888_zenbu⟧: all, everything (opposite of sense 1)
- ⟦{大部分|だいぶぶん}→大部分：03420_daibubun⟧: most, the greater part
- ⟦{一部分|いちぶぶん}→一部分：25727_ichibubun⟧: a portion (more explicit than {一部|いちぶ})
